subtopics.content: Areas covered, production of articles, characteristics of materials and tools, techniques, and combining materials
subtopics.objective: Understand coiled work, woven articles, frame works, and macramé. Learn techniques of weaving, plaiting, coiling, stitching, knotting, and construction to make baskets, hats, mats, nets, footwear, cots, and rattles using materials like cowries, gourds, and beads.

subtopics.content: Creative material use, skill acquisition, and tourism
subtopics.objective: Understand the creative use of new materials for articles of cultural, functional, and aesthetic value, acquiring skills for employment, further study, and tourism promotion.

topics.title: History, Social, Cultural and Economic Importance

subtopics.content: Origin, social, cultural, and economic roles of basketry
subtopics.objective: Trace the origin of basketry and evaluate its social (entertainment), cultural, and economic importance in agriculture and commerce.
Examine the contributions of various people and places to the development and practice of basketry.

subtopics.content: Knowledge, creative skills, values, and work attitudes
subtopics.objective: Develop creative thinking, weaving, and designing skills alongside values such as tolerance, diligence, honesty, commitment, time management, and communication skills.

subtopics.content: Natural, synthetic, flexible, and stiff materials
subtopics.objective: Identify and classify natural, synthetic, flexible/pliable, and stiff/rigid materials used in basketry.

subtopics.content: Drying, wetting, storage, care, and ecology preservation
subtopics.objective: Master skills for preparing materials (drying, wetting), chemical/non-chemical storage methods, environmental preservation, and discovering material characteristics for article making.

subtopics.content: Tool categories, descriptions, drawing, improvisation, and care
subtopics.objective: Describe and draw basketry tools, understand their functions, practice tool improvisation, safety precautions, and routine maintenance.

subtopics.content: Design elements, principles, 12-point colour wheel, and Ghanaian symbolism
subtopics.objective: Identify and create design elements (dots, lines, shapes, textures) and principles (unity, balance, proportion, repetition) using weaving, knotting, scorching, and spraying. Apply the 12-point colour wheel and Ghanaian colour concepts/symbolism.

subtopics.content: Definition of design and idea creation
subtopics.objective: Define design and generate creative ideas through memory, imagination, observation, and correct tool/material usage.

topics.title: Designing Articles to Suit Specific Needs

subtopics.content: Manual and computer designing, appreciation, and evaluation criteria
subtopics.objective: Design functional articles by hand or computer using weaving, knotting, plaiting, coiling, stitching, and framing. Evaluate items based on material, colour, technique, and finishing.

subtopics.content: Raw material sustainability, industry challenges, and solutions
subtopics.objective: Explore raw material sustainability strategies (re-afforestation, waste management), address challenges like plastic competition, and promote co-operatives.
Apply decorative processes (coloured weavers, weave variations, scorching, spraying) and finishing techniques (wrapping, binding, singeing, trimming, lashing, sanding, varnishing, borders).

subtopics.content: Portfolio, business plan, exhibitions, packaging, and pricing
subtopics.objective: Develop portfolios, structure business plans (registration, capital, location, survey), organize exhibitions, execute promotion, design primary/secondary/tertiary packaging, and calculate variable/fixed costs and pricing.
